summary: Focused testing session on the 5 NEW items from this session: (1) mobile ClinicFlow consultation CSS layout fix, (2) public home page + login-modal gating instead of full-page login wall, (3) 'Our Other Apps' section with copyable vanity share links, (4) mobile horizontal-overflow fix, (5) SuperMemory backend persistence (books+tags) and new standalone /supermemory page. All 5 items verified working correctly via Playwright + pytest. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases for /api/supermemory/* passed. Light regression on admin dashboard was skipped (pre-existing admin account password from a prior session is unknown/not documented, not a blocker for this session's scope) — everything else regressed fine (ClinicFlow consultation flow, SuperSummary Template Library, home->feature navigation all working).

issues: Settings modal shows an 'Admin: Agent Instructions' section with editable Generic/Detailed instruction textareas + 'Save Instructions'/'Reset to Default' buttons even for a regular (non-admin) logged-in user. This is a pre-existing Phase 2-7 feature, not part of this session's changes, so flagging only as an observation for main agent to double check the intended audience of this section (should probably be admin-gated or reworded if intentionally global).

action_items: No blocking action items — all 5 targeted features verified working end-to-end.

Optional: review whether the 'Admin: Agent Instructions' block in SettingsPanel.jsx should be gated to admin-only users (currently visible to regular users too) — pre-existing, not introduced this session.
Clean up test data: several TEST_ prefixed users created via UI/pytest during this session (TEST_user_*, TEST_mobile_*, TEST_supermemory_* @example.com), and their associated pdf_books/pdf_tags docs.
critical_code_review_comments: supermemory.py: clean async/await usage, ownership checks scoped by user_id on all book/tag operations, proper 404s, _id excluded via {'_id': 0} projections and _serialize() helper. delete_book correctly does a soft-delete (is_deleted flag) then cleans up dangling tag sources and removes tags left with zero sources — good referential integrity handling.

storage.py: simple, stateless put/get wrapper around Emergent object storage with lazy session-scoped storage_key init; resp.raise_for_status() ensures failures surface as 500s rather than silently returning corrupt data — acceptable for this scope.
main.jsx vanity redirect logic executes before React mounts (window.location.replace) which is correct and fast — confirmed both /moproprep and /dnbproprep redirect instantly with no flash of app UI.

App.jsx requireAuth() pattern is clean: guest clicks are gated with a callback closure, but note the callback itself is NOT persisted/replayed automatically after login succeeds inside the modal (user must click the card a second time post-signup) — this matches the documented/expected behavior in the review request, so not a bug, just confirming the UX matches spec.
ShareLinkRow copy button correctly does not bubble the click to the parent Card's onClick (verified: clicking Copy did not open the login modal).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 targeted feature areas + mobile regressions passed)

Pytest run created and cleaned up its own TEST_supermemory_* user + book + 2 tags automatically (books/tags deleted at end of test, but the user account itself is not deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 session-specific features (mobile ClinicFlow CSS fix, public home + login modal gating, Our Other Apps share links, mobile horizontal-overflow fix, SuperMemory backend persistence + standalone page) are fully verified working via both Playwright and pytest. Verified concretely: consultation-main height tracks scrollHeight (not collapsed) across 4 consecutive answered questions on 390x844 mobile viewport with sticky header remaining reachable; document.documentElement.scrollWidth === window.innerWidth (390) on home/SuperSummary/Settings-open/Settings-closed; vanity redirects for /moproprep and /dnbproprep confirmed via final page.url after navigation; SuperMemory book upload survives a hard reload of the /supermemory tab (backend persistence proven) and unauthenticated visits show the friendly signin-required message. Did NOT deep-retest Phase1-7 flows (admin dashboard, community publish/rate, rating prompt) per instructions - only a light path check was possible since the pre-existing admin test password is undocumented; recommend the next agent create a fresh admin test account or have main agent record the correct password in test_credentials.md.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found this session - all fixes verified against their described root causes: (1) CSS grid auto-row-sizing fix confirmed via getBoundingClientRect().height tracking scrollHeight rather than collapsing near 0; (2) AuthGate no longer wraps guests, only gates onboarding for authenticated users missing profession/mobile, confirmed via home page being visible pre-login; (4) overflow-x:hidden on html/body confirmed eliminates horizontal scroll in all tested states including the previously-implicated Settings drawer open/close cycle.
